0022600127.text: The Warriors are 0-2 and on a two-game losing streak, sitting 13th in the West and 2 games back in the Pacific, while the Nuggets are 0-1 and 12th in the West. Golden State's unavailable players are Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (rest), and Denver's are Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Warriors lost the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
